title: Theo and the Inheritance
author: Petra Okonkwo
blurb: Hazel Oyelaran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
